question:
In the sentence "The mechanical extraction of minerals may cause irreversible damage to species uniquely adapted to these high-pressure, low-light environments — many of which remain undiscovered,"

The clause "**many of which5 remain undiscovered**" is an example of which type of clause?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **relative clause** (or adjective clause) provides additional information about a noun that precedes it. It typically begins with a relative pronoun like *who, whom, whose, that,* or **which**.
 
• In the provided sentence, the clause **"many of which remain undiscovered"** uses the relative pronoun &
